reasoning:
I reviewed each provided helper function and evaluated whether it could help change the title of a CMS page named "Privacy Policy" to the desired text. Summary decision: none of the listed helpers are suitable because they focus on dashboard widgets, reporting, CSV export, store view/date-range selection, or customer-grid exports — none provide functionality to locate and edit CMS pages or update page titles.

Per-function determinations:
- get_dashboard_summary: Not useful — reads dashboard widgets and summary text; does not edit CMS pages.
- generate_sales_summary_for_date_range: Not useful — selects date ranges on dashboard and captures snapshots; no CMS editing capabilities.
- export_dashboard_snapshot: Not useful — navigates and exports dashboard text for monitoring; cannot modify page content.
- extract_last_orders_csv: Not useful — extracts Last Orders table as CSV; unrelated to editing site pages.
- summarize_top_search_terms_across_store_views: Not useful — discovers search-term widgets across store views and parses them; does not edit pages.
- download_revenue_and_orders_report: Not useful — composes revenue and orders reports from dashboard; read-only parsing/export logic only.
- get_last_orders_csv: Not useful — wrapper to extract orders CSV; no CMS editing function.
- fetch_recent_orders_csv: Not useful — lightweight wrapper for getting orders CSV; read-only.
- export_orders_csv: Not useful — exports Last Orders table with column filtering; not for editing CMS content.
- save_recent_orders_csv: Not useful — saves CSV to disk; I/O helper, not a page-editing helper.
- export_revenue_and_orders: Not useful — high-level wrapper for revenue+orders; read-only/exporting only.
- download_last_orders_summary: Not useful — delegates to export_orders_csv and parses CSV; no editing.
- download_recent_orders_csv: Not useful — convenience wrapper to get recent orders CSV; not editing-related.
- save_last_orders_csv: Not useful — validates dashboard presence and writes CSV; does not change site content.
- export_last_orders_csv_simple: Not useful — simple wrapper around export_orders_csv; no CMS edit features.
- export_last_orders_for_store_and_range: Not useful — wrapper to return Last Orders CSV for store/range; no editing.
- export_recent_orders_quick: Not useful — lightweight wrapper to export orders CSV; read-only.
- export_customers_csv_via_grid: Not useful — navigates to Customers management and exports CSV; unrelated to editing a CMS page title.

Conclusion and recommended next step: none of these helpers can perform CMS page editing. To change the "Privacy Policy" page title you need a helper that navigates to the CMS/Pages (or Content > Pages) editor in your site's admin, locates the specific page (by title or slug), opens its edit form, modifies the title field, and saves/publishes the page. None of the provided functions implement those actions.
